before_action.text: 「清点记录和体外循环准备单已经备齐。」
before_action.text_en: “The count record and bypass preparation checklist are ready.”

before_action.text: 「先想清楚，今天究竟要保留什么。」
before_action.text_en: “First, be clear about what we're preserving today.”

before_action.text: 「先核对影像，确认今天重建的上下界。」
before_action.text_en: “Let's check the imaging and confirm the proximal and distal extent of the repair.”

after_resolution.text: 「胸骨切开所需器械在主台。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The sternotomy instruments are on the main table.”

before_action.text: 「正中入路。先把胸骨后方安全地暴露出来。」
before_action.text_en: “Midline approach. First, expose the space behind the sternum safely.”

before_action.text: 「入路要干净。别在真正的手术开始前浪费视野。」
before_action.text_en: “Keep the approach clean. Don't waste exposure before the real work begins.”

before_action.text: 「胸骨锯和止血材料在手边。」
before_action.text_en: “The sternal saw and hemostatic supplies are at hand.”

after_resolution.text: 「通气和循环监测继续。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Ventilation and circulatory monitoring continue.”

before_action.text: 「我来维持心包牵引，给升主动脉留足空间。」
before_action.text_en: “I'll maintain pericardial traction and keep the ascending aorta in view.”

before_action.text: 「你的目标在根部，眼睛也得留给正常的升主动脉。」
before_action.text_en: “Your target is the root, but keep the healthy ascending aorta in view.”

before_action.text: 「正常的远端段也要看清，别只盯着瘤体。」
before_action.text_en: “We need a clear view of the healthy distal segment, not just the aneurysm.”

after_resolution.text: 「下一阶段的插管和阻断器械已经分类放好。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The cannulation and clamping instruments for the next stage are arranged.”

before_action.text: 「体外循环师在位，抗凝检查正在最后核对。」
before_action.text_en: “The perfusionist is standing by. The anticoagulation check is in its final review.”

before_action.text: 「要上体外循环了。你判断什么条件满足以后才能转机？」
before_action.text_en: “We're approaching bypass. What conditions must be met before going on pump?”

before_action.text: 「抗凝达到要求、插管位置和回流路径都确认，才能安全转机。」
before_action.text_en: “Only after anticoagulation, cannulation sites, and venous return are verified can we safely go on bypass.”

after_resolution.text: 「体外循环已经建立，继续监测灌注和体温。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Bypass is established. We'll keep monitoring perfusion and temperature.”

after_resolution.text: 「看到了吗？交给机器的是循环，不是我们的责任。」
after_resolution.text_en: “See? We hand circulation to the machine, not our responsibility.”

precision_failed.text: 「别硬顶。插管的角度不对，先停下来重新确认。」
precision_failed.text_en: “Don't force it. The cannulation angle is wrong. Stop and reassess.”

before_action.text: 「阻断前再核对心肌保护方案。」
before_action.text_en: “Let's verify myocardial protection before cross-clamping.”

before_action.text: 「停搏是争取来的时间，不是可以随便浪费的时间。」
before_action.text_en: “Cardiac arrest gives us a window of time, not time to waste.”

before_action.text: 「确认后阻断，按计划给予心肌保护。」
before_action.text_en: “Once confirmed, cross-clamp and administer cardioplegia as planned.”

after_resolution.text: 「根部术野已充分暴露。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The root is adequately exposed.”

before_action.text: 「打开病变根部，先看瓣叶。」
before_action.text_en: “Open the diseased root and examine the leaflets first.”

before_action.text: 「看瓣叶。别让五点三厘米这个数字替你做保瓣决定。」
before_action.text_en: “Look at the leaflets. Don't let that five-point-three-centimeter number make the valve decision for you.”

before_action.text: 「测量器械与细钳。」
before_action.text_en: “Measuring instruments and fine forceps.”

after_resolution.text: 「心肌保护依既定节奏继续维护。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Myocardial protection is being maintained on schedule.”

after_resolution.text: 「好。保瓣有条件，你没有忘。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Good. You remembered that valve preservation has conditions.”

before_action.text: 「我牵开窦壁，避免压迫冠状动脉开口。」
before_action.text_en: “I'll retract the sinus wall without compressing the coronary ostia.”

before_action.text: 「冠状动脉开口不能靠力气拉出来。留够活动度。」
before_action.text_en: “You can't free a coronary ostium by force. Leave it enough mobility.”

before_action.text: 「给冠脉钮留足组织边缘和活动余量。」
before_action.text_en: “Preserve sufficient tissue margins and mobility for the coronary buttons.”

after_resolution.text: 「冠脉吻合的细线和器械已备妥。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The fine sutures and instruments for coronary reimplantation are ready.”

before_action.text: 「测量瓣环和瓣交界高度，先确定几何关系。」
before_action.text_en: “Measure the annulus and commissural heights before deciding the geometry.”

before_action.text: 「别先选人工血管再去迎合它。尺寸要服从解剖。」
before_action.text_en: “Don't pick a graft and force the anatomy to fit. Let the anatomy determine the size.”

before_action.text: 「根部外侧牵引由我保持。」
before_action.text_en: “I'll maintain the external root exposure.”

after_resolution.text: 「人工血管尺寸记录已交给主台核对。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The graft sizing notes have been passed to the main table for confirmation.”

precision_failed.text: 「尺寸不是猜出来的。把瓣环和交界的测量重做一遍。」
precision_failed.text_en: “You don't guess the size. Repeat the annular and commissural measurements.”

before_action.text: 「基底环缝线与人工血管已经在台。」
before_action.text_en: “The basal ring sutures and graft are on the field.”

before_action.text: 「这一圈缝线决定整个根部稳不稳。别赶。」
before_action.text_en: “This ring of sutures determines whether the root is secure. Don't rush.”

before_action.text: 「这一圈按顺序走，注意不要伤到附近结构。」
before_action.text_en: “Work around the ring in sequence, protecting the adjacent structures.”

after_resolution.text: 「近端牵引角度保持，准备下一步。」
after_resolution.text_en: “I'll maintain the proximal exposure for the next step.”

precision_failed.text: 「针脚层次偏了。不能为了赶进度牺牲根部支撑。」
precision_failed.text_en: “That stitch is in the wrong plane. Don't sacrifice root support to save time.”

before_action.text: 「三个瓣交界的参照位置都能看清。」
before_action.text_en: “All three commissural reference points are visible.”

before_action.text: 「先看三个交界的相对高度，别只盯着某一片瓣叶。」
before_action.text_en: “Compare all three commissural heights. Don't fixate on one leaflet.”

before_action.text: 「先校准高度，再固定瓣叶的空间位置。」
before_action.text_en: “Set the heights first, then secure the geometry of the leaflets.”

after_resolution.text: 「下一组细缝线已准备好。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The next set of fine sutures is ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「高度可以调整，盲目的自信可调整不了。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Commissural heights can be adjusted. Blind confidence can't.”

precision_failed.text: 「交界高度没对齐。停，重新找准基准。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The commissural heights aren't aligned. Stop and reset the reference.”

before_action.text: 「检查对合高度，按计划做瓣膜测试。」
before_action.text_en: “Check the coaptation height and perform the planned valve test.”

before_action.text: 「对合不够好，就调整。‘差不多’不是一个检查结果。」
before_action.text_en: “If coaptation isn't good enough, adjust it. ‘Close enough’ isn't a test result.”

before_action.text: 「我从另一侧看瓣缘位置。」
before_action.text_en: “I'll check the leaflet edges from the opposite side.”

after_resolution.text: 「结果先记录，复灌以后还要用超声复核。」
after_resolution.text_en: “We'll document this test, then reassess with ultrasound after reperfusion.”

after_resolution.text: 「现在你应该明白，为什么刚才那针不能省。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Now you should understand why that earlier stitch couldn't be omitted.”

before_action.text: 「左冠脉钮由我托住，不施加额外牵拉。」
before_action.text_en: “I'll support the left coronary button without additional traction.”

before_action.text: 「左冠状动脉最怕你忽略它的方向，不怕你慢。」
before_action.text_en: “The left coronary artery doesn't mind you taking time. It minds you ignoring its course.”

before_action.text: 「先看血管走向，再下第一针。」
before_action.text_en: “Check the vessel's course before placing the first stitch.”

after_resolution.text: 「吻合线与备用细线保持在主台。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The anastomotic and spare fine sutures remain on the main table.”

precision_failed.text: 「左冠开口承受不了这种张力。退回来。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The left coronary button can't tolerate that tension. Back up.”

before_action.text: 「右冠脉吻合所需细针线已经换上。」
before_action.text_en: “The fine needles and sutures for the right coronary anastomosis are ready.”

before_action.text: 「别只盯着针尖。退一步，看整条血管有没有扭。」
before_action.text_en: “Don't stare only at the needle. Step back and see whether the whole vessel is twisted.”

before_action.text: 「注意开口方向，不能留下扭曲和张力。」
before_action.text_en: “Mind the ostial orientation. We must not leave twisting or tension.”

after_resolution.text: 「牵拉暂时解除，方便检查血管走向。」
after_resolution.text_en: “I'll release traction so we can inspect the vessel's course.”

precision_failed.text: 「这次不是针线的问题。你忽略了整条血管的走向。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The problem isn't the suture this time. You lost sight of the vessel's course.”

before_action.text: 「把人工血管和正常的远端升主动脉接起来。」
before_action.text_en: “Anastomose the graft to the healthy distal ascending aorta.”

before_action.text: 「远端这一接，重建的几何就定下来了。想清楚再落针。」
before_action.text_en: “This distal anastomosis sets the final geometry. Think before placing the stitch.”

before_action.text: 「血管缝线和止血材料已备妥。」
before_action.text_en: “Vascular sutures and hemostatic supplies are ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「吻合口外观开始逐段复核。」
after_resolution.text_en: “We'll inspect the completed anastomosis segment by segment.”

precision_failed.text: 「远端口径没接顺。再看一眼整体几何。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The distal diameters aren't matched smoothly. Recheck the overall geometry.”

before_action.text: 「排气与复灌的步骤已经和团队核对，经食道超声准备观察。」
before_action.text_en: “The de-airing and reperfusion sequence is agreed. TEE is ready for assessment.”

before_action.text: 「放开阻断钳之前，先说清楚排气为什么不能省。」
before_action.text_en: “Before releasing the cross-clamp, tell me why de-airing cannot be skipped.”

before_action.text: 「残留气体可能进入冠状动脉或体循环。排气完成，才能按步骤恢复灌注。」
before_action.text_en: “Residual air could enter the coronaries or systemic circulation. We complete de-airing before restoring flow in sequence.”

after_resolution.text: 「冠状动脉灌注恢复，瓣膜与心室功能继续复核。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Coronary perfusion has resumed. We continue evaluating the valve and ventricular function.”

after_resolution.text: 「别急着庆祝心脏跳起来。先看它跳得有没有效。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Don't celebrate the heart beating yet. First check whether it is pumping effectively.”

before_action.text: 「节律、收缩功能与血流动力学一起评估，准备逐步降低支持。」
before_action.text_en: “We'll assess rhythm, contractility, and hemodynamics together before reducing support.”

before_action.text: 「我不替你说可以脱机。坂口，你自己把证据凑齐。」
before_action.text_en: “I won't tell you it's safe to wean. Sakaguchi, assemble the evidence yourself.”

before_action.text: 「看超声、心室收缩和节律，也看每个吻合部位有没有出血。缺一项都不能急。」
before_action.text_en: “I need the echo, ventricular function, rhythm, and bleeding checks at every anastomosis. We don't rush if one is missing.”

after_resolution.text: 「后续止血与转出所需物资在台外待命。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Supplies for further hemostasis and transfer are standing by outside the sterile field.”

after_resolution.text: 「很好。你开始像真正的主刀那样，看完整台手术了。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Good. You're beginning to see the whole operation the way a lead surgeon should.”

precision_failed.text: 「还不能脱机。先说哪一项证据不够。」
precision_failed.text_en: “We're not ready to wean. Tell me which piece of evidence is missing.”

before_action.text: 「最终器械清点与巡回共同核对中。」
before_action.text_en: “The final instrument count is being verified with the circulating nurse.”

before_action.text: 「最后的整齐，不能靠把问题缝在里面。」
before_action.text_en: “A tidy finish doesn't mean sewing a problem out of sight.”

before_action.text: 「确认止血、引流和关胸范围，再关闭。」
before_action.text_en: “Verify hemostasis, drains, and the closure field before closing.”

after_resolution.text: 「转出前的监测与支持交接开始。」
after_resolution.text_en: “We're beginning the monitoring and support handoff for transfer.”
